name: Zilliz Cloud
tagline: Fully managed vector database service built on open-source Milvus.
description: Zilliz Cloud is a fully managed vector database from the creators of Milvus. It runs billion-scale similarity search for RAG, semantic search, and AI applications without the operational burden of self-hosting, offering a free serverless tier, auto-scaling serverless, and dedicated clusters across major clouds. Features include GPU-accelerated indexing, tiered storage, and hybrid dense/sparse search.
insight: Built by the original creators of Milvus, the open-source vector DB they donated to the LF AI & Data Foundation.
edge: Managed Milvus from its original creators — a free serverless tier scaling to billion-vector dedicated clusters, with GPU indexing and tiered storage.
pros: Free serverless tier, no card required
cons: The managed service itself is proprietary
Costs grow with compute and scale
Vector DB only, not a full RAG stack
